description: Publish raw HTML as a branded, password-protected (zero-knowledge AES-256) link on your own domain. Returns the URL and (if locked) the password. Locked by default.

expire.description: Auto-expire after this long: '7d', '24h', '2w', or a date. Enforce deletion with the host's `hush gc` cron.

html.description: The full HTML document to publish.

lock.description: Encrypt + password-protect (default true). Set false for a public branded page.

password.description: Set a specific password. Otherwise an unguessable one is generated when locked.

slug.description: Force the URL slug (e.g. 'q3-report'). Otherwise auto-generated.

name: publish_html
